text:
rahul: Heads up 1f4e2 I'm traveling to India during my partner's delivery window and need to confirm parental leave start/end dates across timezones. Do we just use the local date where I'm working or the birth timezone for the leave start? Also any paperwork differences?
maria: Congrats, rahul! Use the local date where you are contracted (your employment country) for HR systems. For cross-border births, attach the child's birth certificate and note the timezone in the leave form. People-ops will handle benefits coordination for international cases.
people-ops-bot: Parental leave form (intl guidance): https://intranet.redwood/hr/leave-form-international. Processing may take longer if documents require notarization.
rahul: Thanks 60a Also, do we have any visa-related paid leave extensions or support for partner relocation after birth?
emily: We can provide limited relocation travel reimbursement for primary caregivers in international cases, subject to manager and people-ops approval. Submit travel receipts and approval via expense portal; tag @people-ops. For visa questions, coordinate with people-ops + legal; we don't auto-extend visas for leave but can support sponsor letters.
recruiter-bot: If you're concerned about backfill while abroad, consider a contractor or internal transfer request. For short windows we can also temporary swap project tasks. Typical contractor lead time is 5-10 business days.
rahul: Helpful. Lastly, can I request the company to block my probation/performance review deadlines while I'm out? I'll be in probation extension until 3 months after return.
maria: We can pause or extend probation timelines for parental leave; submit a probation extension request form and we'll route for approval.
rahul: Great thanks, filing forms now.
